remarks: Welcome to 3518 Rawley Street in Corona! A rare opportunity to own a spacious single-story residence in a desirable community, offering approximately 2,512 square feet of living space, 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, beautiful mountain views, and an impressive collection of upgrades throughout. Single-story homes of this size are a rare find in the area, making this property especially appealing for those seeking comfort, convenience, and an expansive layout. Inside, you'll discover beautiful 16x16 tile flooring throughout the main living areas, newer carpeting in the bedrooms, elegant wood shutters, energy-efficient recessed lighting, ceiling fans in every room, and a built-in entertainment cab
